null_convention: Empty string in CSV, null in JSON. NA is not used.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one physical collection event. Format ZW-SMP-YYYY-NNN. Never reissued.

fields.name: collection_event_id
fields.description: Groups samples taken on the same trip to the same site.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Foreign key to governance/source_register.csv.

fields.name: ecozone
fields.description: Sampling stratum.

fields.name: province
fields.description: Administrative province.

fields.name: district
fields.description: Administrative district.

fields.name: ward
fields.description: Ward. Finest geographic unit released publicly.

fields.name: land_tenure
fields.description: Tenure class of the site, which determines which permission applies.

fields.name: gps_latitude
fields.description: Latitude. Field capture is at four or more decimal places; public release carries the ward centroid with location_masked set.

fields.name: gps_longitude
fields.description: Longitude. Same masking rule as latitude.

fields.name: gps_precision_m
fields.description: Radius of positional uncertainty in metres. 5000 indicates ward-centroid masking; 5 indicates raw field GPS.

fields.name: location_masked
fields.description: Whether the coordinates in this record have been blurred for release.

fields.name: altitude_m
fields.description: Metres above sea level.

fields.name: sample_type
fields.description: Nature of the material collected.

fields.name: collection_depth_cm
fields.description: Depth below surface. Required when sample_type is soil.

fields.name: local_name
fields.description: Vernacular name as given in the field.

fields.name: local_name_language
fields.description: ISO 639-1 tag for the vernacular name.

fields.name: scientific_name
fields.description: Binomial where determined. Null is valid for soil and microbial samples.

fields.name: taxon_confidence
fields.description: How the identification was established.

fields.name: voucher_specimen_ref
fields.description: National Herbarium accession where a voucher was lodged.

fields.name: collection_date
fields.description: Date of collection.

fields.name: season
fields.description: Dry or wet, per the collection date.

fields.name: soil_ph
fields.description: Field-measured soil pH.

fields.name: temperature_celsius
fields.description: Ambient temperature at collection.

fields.name: rainfall_prior_30d_mm
fields.description: Cumulative rainfall over the 30 days before collection.

fields.name: canopy_cover_pct
fields.description: Estimated canopy cover above the collection point.

fields.name: collector_id
fields.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the field collector.

fields.name: preservation_method
fields.description: How the sample was stabilised.

fields.name: minutes_to_preservation
fields.description: Elapsed minutes from collection to stabilisation.

fields.name: processing_lab
fields.description: Facility that processed the sample. MOBILE-LEC-01 denotes the field unit.

fields.name: chain_of_custody_ref
fields.description: Custody document for this physical sample.

fields.name: heritage_use_ref
fields.description: Foreign key to the heritage record that directed this collection. Null means the sample was chosen on ecological criteria alone.

fields.name: consent_reference
fields.description: Consent document under which knowledge-led collection proceeded. Required whenever heritage_use_ref is present.

fields.name: nba_permit_ref
fields.description: National Biotechnology Authority bioprospecting permit reference.

fields.name: access_permit_ref
fields.description: Protected-area access clearance. Required on state protected land.

fields.name: sequencing_status
fields.description: Progress of Stream A processing for this sample.

fields.name: lc_ms_status
fields.description: Progress of Stream B processing for this sample.

fields.name: data_sensitivity
fields.description: Release classification for this record.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Ingest timestamp.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Lifecycle state. Redacted records are excluded from every release.

fields.name: sequence_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one sequencing run product. Format ZW-SEQ-YYYY-NNN.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.description: Foreign key to the physical sample.

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Sequencing instrument class.

fields.name: library_prep_kit
fields.description: Library preparation chemistry.

fields.name: flowcell_id
fields.description: Physical flowcell identifier.

fields.name: basecalling_model
fields.description: Exact basecaller and model version.

fields.name: run_date
fields.description: Date the sequencing run started.

fields.name: sequencing_lab
fields.description: Facility or mobile unit that performed the run.

fields.name: target_region
fields.description: Amplicon target or shotgun designation.

fields.name: read_count
fields.description: Reads passing filter.

fields.name: total_bases
fields.description: Total bases passing filter.

fields.name: mean_read_length_bp
fields.description: Mean read length.

fields.name: read_n50_bp
fields.description: Read length N50.

fields.name: mean_q_score
fields.description: Mean Phred quality across reads.

fields.name: assembly_method
fields.description: Assembler and version where assembly was performed.

fields.name: assembly_n50_bp
fields.description: Assembly contiguity.

fields.name: contig_count
fields.description: Number of contigs produced.

fields.name: taxonomic_assignment
fields.description: Best taxonomic call for the sequence.

fields.name: assignment_method
fields.description: Classifier and reference database version.

fields.name: organism_novelty
fields.description: Novelty label against GenBank. See labels/label_taxonomy.csv LBL-01.

fields.name: best_blast_accession
fields.description: Closest GenBank accession.

fields.name: best_blast_pct_identity
fields.description: Percent identity to the closest known sequence.

fields.name: predicted_function
fields.description: Model-predicted function, recorded with the model that produced it. LBL-02.

fields.name: disease_target_relevance
fields.description: Model-estimated relevance to a declared disease target. LBL-03.

fields.name: annotation_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the annotation itself. LBL-04.

fields.name: bgc_count
fields.description: Secondary metabolite gene clusters detected by antiSMASH.

fields.name: heritage_link
fields.description: Denormalised tk_id of the heritage record that directed the parent sample. LBL-08.

fields.name: file_path_fasta
fields.description: Relative path to the sequence file within the package.

fields.name: file_checksum_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the referenced file.

fields.name: file_size_bytes
fields.description: Size of the referenced file.

fields.name: data_sensitivity
fields.description: Release classification for this record.

fields.name: qc_status
fields.description: Outcome of the validation battery for this record.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Ingest timestamp.

fields.name: metabolite_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one detected LC-MS feature. Format ZW-MET-YYYY-NNN.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.description: Foreign key to the physical sample.

fields.name: extract_id
fields.description: Identifier of the extract in which the feature was detected.

fields.name: extraction_solvent
fields.description: Solvent system used.

fields.name: extraction_date
fields.description: Date of extraction.

fields.name: instrument
fields.description: Mass spectrometer make and model.

fields.name: chromatography_column
fields.description: Column chemistry and dimensions.

fields.name: ionization_mode
fields.description: Positive or negative ionisation.

fields.name: collision_energy_ev
fields.description: Collision energy applied.

fields.name: retention_time_min
fields.description: Chromatographic retention time.

fields.name: mz_measured
fields.description: Measured mass-to-charge ratio.

fields.name: mz_error_ppm
fields.description: Mass error against the proposed formula.

fields.name: peak_area
fields.description: Integrated peak area, uncorrected.

fields.name: relative_abundance
fields.description: Peak area normalised within the sample.

fields.name: putative_compound_name
fields.description: Proposed identity. Putative unless MSI level 1.

fields.name: molecular_formula
fields.description: Proposed molecular formula.

fields.name: smiles_canonical
fields.description: Canonical SMILES, RDKit-canonicalised at ingest.

fields.name: inchikey
fields.description: 27-character InChIKey where structure is established.

fields.name: msi_annotation_level
fields.description: Metabolomics Standards Initiative confidence level. LBL-06.

fields.name: spectral_library
fields.description: Library matched against.

fields.name: library_match_score
fields.description: Spectral match score.

fields.name: external_db_hit
fields.description: Accession in an external natural-product or compound database.

fields.name: compound_class
fields.description: Putative activity class. LBL-05.

fields.name: compound_novelty
fields.description: Novelty label against external databases. LBL-07.

fields.name: annotation_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the annotation itself. LBL-04.

fields.name: file_path_mzml
fields.description: Relative path to the raw mzML file.

fields.name: file_checksum_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the referenced file.

fields.name: data_sensitivity
fields.description: Release classification. LC-MS profiles are commercially valuable and default to internal.

fields.name: qc_status
fields.description: Outcome of the validation battery for this record.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Ingest timestamp.

fields.name: tk_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one documented item of heritage knowledge. Format ZW-TK-YYYY-NNN.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Foreign key to governance/source_register.csv (ZW-SRC-004).

fields.name: holder_pseudonym_id
fields.description: Pseudonymous holder identifier. Resolves to a named person only through the encrypted Holder Identity Register held by SIRDC, which is distributed at no access tier.

fields.name: community_council_id
fields.description: Council that endorsed the interview.

fields.name: council_endorsement_ref
fields.description: Collective endorsement document.

fields.name: consent_reference
fields.description: Individual FPIC document. Required; a record without one cannot be written.

fields.name: consent_date
fields.description: Date consent was given. Must not be later than the interview date.

fields.name: collection_language
fields.description: Language the interview was conducted in.

fields.name: interview_date
fields.description: Date of the interview.

fields.name: interviewer_id
fields.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the community liaison.

fields.name: knowledge_type
fields.description: Category of knowledge recorded.

fields.name: local_plant_name
fields.description: Plant name as the holder gave it.

fields.name: language_tag
fields.description: ISO 639-1 tag: sn Shona, nd Ndebele, en English.

fields.name: scientific_name
fields.description: Binomial, verified after collection against the National Herbarium.

fields.name: disease_target_local
fields.description: Description of use, verbatim in the source language. Never paraphrased without consent.

fields.name: disease_target_en
fields.description: English translation. Derived, and flagged as such.

fields.name: translation_status
fields.description: Whether a bilingual reviewer has verified the translation. LBL-09.

fields.name: disease_target_icd11
fields.description: ICD-11 mapping of the indication where one exists.

fields.name: preparation_method
fields.description: Preparation as described, verbatim.

fields.name: preparation_class
fields.description: Controlled-vocabulary rendering of the preparation.

fields.name: plant_part_used
fields.description: Part of the plant used.

fields.name: administration_route
fields.description: Route of administration.

fields.name: seasonality_of_use
fields.description: When in the year the preparation is used or harvested.

fields.name: province
fields.description: Province of the originating community.

fields.name: district
fields.description: District of the originating community. The default attribution unit.

fields.name: ward
fields.description: Ward of the originating community.

fields.name: named_attribution_opt_in
fields.description: Whether the holder has explicitly opted into being named in publications.

fields.name: sensitivity_level
fields.description: Holder-assigned classification. The constraint admits public and community-restricted only; sacred is absent by design and cannot be stored.

fields.name: data_sensitivity
fields.description: Release classification under the Annex B vocabulary.

fields.name: benefit_sharing_agreement_ref
fields.description: Benefit-sharing agreement, signed before collection.

fields.name: withdrawal_status
fields.description: Whether the holder has withdrawn consent.

fields.name: withdrawal_date
fields.description: Date withdrawal was received. Starts the 30-day action clock.

fields.name: audio_recording_ref
fields.description: Reference to the consented audio recording, restricted tier only.

fields.name: bilingual_validation_status
fields.description: Whether a second bilingual reviewer confirmed the record.

fields.name: validator_id
fields.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the bilingual validator.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Ingest timestamp.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Lifecycle state.

fields.name: qc_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one validation event. Format ZW-QC-YYYY-NNN.

fields.name: target_table
fields.description: Table the check was run against.

fields.name: target_record_id
fields.description: Identifier of the record checked.

fields.name: check_name
fields.description: Name of the check performed.

fields.name: quality_dimension
fields.description: Which of the seven Minimum Expectations quality dimensions this check covers.

fields.name: check_type
fields.description: Category of check.

fields.name: check_result
fields.description: Pass, warning or fail.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity of the finding.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable finding.

fields.name: checked_by
fields.description: Automated, human audit, or bilingual validator.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the check.

fields.name: issue_owner
fields.description: Person accountable for resolving the finding.

fields.name: correction_action
fields.description: Action taken or required.

fields.name: corrected_at
fields.description: Timestamp of correction.

fields.name: corrected_by
fields.description: Who actioned the correction.

fields.name: resolution_status
fields.description: Open, resolved or waived. A critical finding cannot be waived without a recorded action and owner.

views.v_provenance_chain: For any compound: holder pseudonym, endorsing council and signed benefit-sharing agreement.
views.v_withdrawal_impact: Every downstream record requiring action inside the 30-day withdrawal commitment.
